quests.instruction: Your teacher says, 'It's clean-up time.' What do you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Put your materials away and tidy your area 🧹
options: Finish your picture, then tidy up later 🖍️
Take your materials to the next lesson 🎒
Put your materials away and tidy your area 🧹
quests.hint: This signal means the activity is finished.
quests.explanation: Cleaning up together means everything is tidy for the next lesson.
quests.funFact: Many classrooms use a special song or sound to signal tidy-up time.

quests.instruction: You finish your work before everyone else. What is a good choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Check your work quietly 📖
options: Pack your bag early 🎒
Check your work quietly 📖
Talk loudly to your friend 🗣️
quests.hint: Others are still working.
quests.explanation: Using the extra time to check your work or read is useful and doesn't disturb anyone.
quests.funFact: Re-reading your answers often helps you catch small mistakes.

quests.instruction: Your painting is still wet when the art lesson ends. What do you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Put it on the drying rack 🖼️
options: Put it on the drying rack 🖼️
Stack it on top of others 📚
Slide it into your bag 🎒
quests.hint: Wet paint can smudge.
quests.explanation: A drying rack keeps wet paintings flat and separated while they dry.
quests.funFact: Paint can take an hour or more to dry, depending on how thick it is.

quests.instruction: You walk into school after the lesson has already begun. What is the best way to join in?
quests.correctAnswer: Come in quietly and tell your teacher 🙋
options: Come in quietly and tell your teacher 🙋
Walk in and sit down without a word 🪑
Wait outside until the next break ⏳
quests.hint: Don't disturb other students.
quests.explanation: Entering quietly and telling your teacher helps the class carry on while the teacher marks you present.
quests.funFact: Arriving a few minutes early gives time to settle in.

quests.instruction: Why does the teacher take attendance?
quests.correctAnswer: To know who is here and safe ✅
options: To know who is here and safe ✅
To decide who sits where in lessons 🪑
To choose the student of the day 🏆
quests.hint: It's about knowing where everybody is.
quests.explanation: Attendance helps the school know who is present, especially in an emergency.
quests.funFact: Schools keep attendance records for every day of the school year.

quests.instruction: You will be away from school tomorrow because you are sick. Who should let the school know?
quests.correctAnswer: A parent or guardian, by phone or note ☎️
options: Nobody, because the teacher will guess 🤷
Only a classmate 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
A parent or guardian, by phone or note ☎️
quests.hint: The school needs an adult's message.
quests.explanation: A call or note from home tells the school you are safe and why you are away.
quests.funFact: Staying home when sick also helps stop germs from spreading.

quests.instruction: You need the washroom during a lesson. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Raise your hand and ask politely 🙋
options: Leave without telling anyone 🚶
Wait until the end of the day ⏳
Raise your hand and ask politely 🙋
quests.hint: Your teacher needs to know where you are.
quests.explanation: Asking permission lets your teacher know you are safe and helps the lesson go smoothly.
quests.funFact: Many schools have a sign-out sheet or a hall pass for this.

quests.instruction: When you come back from the washroom, what do you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Wash your hands and return to class 🧼
options: Wash your hands and return to class 🧼
Visit a friend in another class 🚪
Stay in the hallway to play 🛝
quests.hint: Think about hygiene and learning time.
quests.explanation: Washing your hands and returning quickly keeps you healthy and makes sure you don't miss the lesson.
quests.funFact: Rubbing your hands with soap for 20 seconds cleans them best.

quests.instruction: Two students ask to go to the washroom at the same time. What usually works best?
quests.correctAnswer: One at a time, back before the next 🚻
options: Both go and take their time ⏱️
One at a time, back before the next 🚻
Both go together and chat on the way 💬
quests.hint: Think about knowing where everyone is.
quests.explanation: Sending one student at a time lets the teacher know where everyone is and keeps the washroom calm.
quests.funFact: Many schools use a hall pass so that only one student is out of the room at a time.

quests.instruction: At school assembly, what should you do while the principal speaks?
quests.correctAnswer: Sit quietly and listen 🤫
options: Whisper to your friends 💬
Sit quietly and listen 🤫
Wave to the crowd 👋
quests.hint: Everybody needs to hear the message.
quests.explanation: Listening quietly shows respect and lets everyone hear the announcements.
quests.funFact: Assemblies often include announcements, songs, and awards.

quests.instruction: Where is a whole-school assembly often held?
quests.correctAnswer: Assembly hall 🏛️
options: Nurse's room 🩺
Library 📚
Assembly hall 🏛️
quests.hint: It needs lots of space for many students.
quests.explanation: The assembly hall or the playground has enough room for many students at once.
quests.funFact: Some assemblies are held outdoors on a field when the weather is nice.

quests.instruction: The school song begins. How should you behave?
quests.correctAnswer: Stand still and join in respectfully 🧍
options: Stand still and join in respectfully 🧍
Sit down and wait for it to finish 🪑
Whisper to your neighbor until it ends 💬
quests.hint: Think about showing respect.
quests.explanation: Standing quietly during a school song or anthem shows respect for your school and others.
quests.funFact: Many schools have a school song or motto that everyone learns.

quests.instruction: Your teacher says, 'Write the date and title.' Where do they go?
quests.correctAnswer: At the top of the page 📓
options: At the top of the page 📓
On the back cover 📕
At the bottom of the page ⬇️
quests.hint: They help you find your work later.
quests.explanation: Writing the date and title at the top helps you find your notes later when you revise.
quests.funFact: Dated pages make a record of what you learned each day.

quests.instruction: You make a mistake in your notebook. What is a neat way to fix it?
quests.correctAnswer: Cross it out with one neat line ✏️
options: Cross it out with one neat line ✏️
Scribble over it until it is black ⬛
Tear out the whole page 📄
quests.hint: Your notebook should stay readable.
quests.explanation: One neat line through the mistake keeps your page tidy, so you can write the correct answer beside it.
quests.funFact: Even adults cross out mistakes with one line, so the page stays readable.

quests.instruction: Your teacher says, 'Turn to page 24.' How do you find it?
quests.correctAnswer: Look for the number printed on the page 🔢
options: Ask a friend to turn to it for you 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
Count the pages from the front cover ☝️
Look for the number printed on the page 🔢
quests.hint: Pages are numbered to help you.
quests.explanation: Printed page numbers help the whole class turn to the same place.
quests.funFact: Page numbers were first used in books hundreds of years ago.

quests.instruction: Your teacher raises a hand and waits for quiet. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Stop talking and look at your teacher 🤚
options: Raise your hand too and keep talking quietly 🙌
Finish your sentence and then look up 🗣️
Stop talking and look at your teacher 🤚
quests.hint: It is a signal for everyone.
quests.explanation: A quiet hand signal lets the teacher get attention without shouting, as long as everyone responds.
quests.funFact: Many teachers use signals like a raised hand, a clap pattern, or a chime.

quests.instruction: Your teacher counts down '3, 2, 1' to end the activity. What do you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Finish your sentence and stop 🤫
options: Start a new line to use up the time ✏️
Finish your sentence and stop 🤫
Speed up and finish before it ends 🏃
quests.hint: The countdown means time is almost up.
quests.explanation: A countdown gives you a moment to finish and then focus on the teacher.
quests.funFact: Countdowns give everyone the same warning, so no one is surprised.

quests.instruction: The teacher announces partner work and says, 'Find a partner.' What do you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Turn to a classmate near you 🤝
options: Work alone and ignore the instruction 🙈
Turn to a classmate near you 🤝
Go and find someone in another class 🚪
quests.hint: Pairing should be quick and fair.
quests.explanation: Pairing up with someone close saves time and gets everyone working together.
quests.funFact: Working in pairs gives you a chance to explain your ideas aloud.

quests.instruction: It is raining hard at break time. What usually happens?
quests.correctAnswer: Students stay inside for an indoor break 🏫
options: Students stay inside for an indoor break 🏫
Students go home until the rain stops 🏠
Everyone plays outside in raincoats 🌧️
quests.hint: Safety first.
quests.explanation: On rainy days many schools keep students inside to play quiet games and stay dry and safe.
quests.funFact: Many schools have a 'wet play' plan with board games or drawing.

quests.instruction: It's a hot, sunny day and you're playing outside. What should you have with you?
quests.correctAnswer: A hat and water 🧢
options: A heavy coat 🧥
A pile of books 📚
A hat and water 🧢
quests.hint: Think about heat and sun.
quests.explanation: A hat protects you from the sun, and water stops you from getting too hot and thirsty.
quests.funFact: Sunburn can happen even on cloudy days.

quests.instruction: After outdoor play, what is the next step before the lesson?
quests.correctAnswer: Line up and wash your hands 🧼
options: Run back to the playground 🏃
Go straight to the lesson with muddy hands 🧤
Line up and wash your hands 🧼
quests.hint: Hands pick up lots of germs outside.
quests.explanation: Washing after outdoor play removes dirt and germs before you touch your books or eat.
quests.funFact: Washing hands is one of the easiest ways to stay healthy.

quests.instruction: Today you are the board monitor. What is your job?
quests.correctAnswer: Clean the board for the next lesson 🧽
options: Lead the class in a line to the gym 🚶
Hand out the lunch trays to the class 🍽️
Clean the board for the next lesson 🧽
quests.hint: The board must be ready for what's next.
quests.explanation: A board monitor wipes the board so the teacher can start the next lesson with a clear space.
quests.funFact: Wiping the board from top to bottom stops dust from landing on the floor.

quests.instruction: You're the line leader today. What is your job?
quests.correctAnswer: Lead the class calmly to where it is going 🚶
options: Hand out and collect all the homework 📥
Lead the class calmly to where it is going 🚶
Decide which students sit in which seats 🪑
quests.hint: You walk first, so you set the pace.
quests.explanation: The line leader walks at a calm pace, so the class can follow safely.
quests.funFact: A good line leader stops at corners and waits for everyone.

quests.instruction: Why do students take turns being class helpers?
quests.correctAnswer: So everyone shares the work and learns 🤝
options: So the teacher has a break from the class 😴
So the fastest student gets all the jobs ⚡
So everyone shares the work and learns 🤝
quests.hint: Think about what each student gains.
quests.explanation: Taking turns means every student gets to help, and the classroom is looked after by everyone.
quests.funFact: The word 'monitor' comes from a Latin word meaning 'to remind or warn'.

quests.instruction: Your timetable says 'Break 10:30 to 10:45.' What happens at 10:30?
quests.correctAnswer: Break begins 🧃
options: Lunch begins 🍽️
Break begins 🧃
School ends 🏠
quests.hint: Read the word next to the time.
quests.explanation: A timetable tells you what happens at each time of day.
quests.funFact: 15 minutes is a quarter of an hour.

quests.instruction: Lunch starts at 12:00. At about 11:55, what is the best thing to do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tidy up and get ready to go 🧹
options: Go home 🏠
Tidy up and get ready to go 🧹
Start a long new project 🖌️
quests.hint: Think about how to finish up before lunch.
quests.explanation: A few minutes before lunch, wrap up your work and prepare, so lunch can start on time.
quests.funFact: The 24-hour clock counts the hours from 0 to 23.

quests.instruction: School ends at 3:00, and your bus leaves at 3:10. When should you start packing?
quests.correctAnswer: About 2:55 🎒
options: About 2:55 🎒
After the bus leaves 🚌
quests.hint: Give yourself enough time.
quests.explanation: Starting to pack a few minutes early means you don't have to rush or miss the bus.
quests.funFact: Our 24-hour day comes from the ancient Egyptians, who split day and night into 12 parts each.

quests.instruction: Which is the best order after you arrive in the morning?
quests.correctAnswer: Hang your bag, get your notebook, sit down 🎒
options: Drop your bag by the door and sit down 🚪
Hang your bag, get your notebook, sit down 🎒
Sit down, then run back to get your bag 🏃
quests.hint: Think about what stays out of the way and what you need.
quests.explanation: A good order keeps the room tidy and gets you ready to learn.
quests.funFact: Many schools start between 8 and 9 in the morning.

quests.instruction: Your teacher is late to class. What is a good thing to do?
quests.correctAnswer: Sit down, get ready, and wait quietly 🪑
options: Start a game in the aisle 🎲
Sit down, get ready, and wait quietly 🪑
Wander off to look for your teacher 🚶
quests.hint: Be ready so the class can start.
quests.explanation: Being ready and calm lets the lesson start smoothly when your teacher arrives.
quests.funFact: Many teachers write a starter task on the board so lessons can begin right away.

quests.instruction: Which routine helps you remember your notebooks and homework every day?
quests.correctAnswer: Check your timetable and diary first 📔
options: Check your timetable and diary first 📔
Pack the same bag as yesterday 🎒
Ask a friend what they are packing 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
quests.hint: Use tools to remember.
quests.explanation: Checking the timetable and diary tells you exactly what to bring.
quests.funFact: Astronauts and pilots use checklists so they never miss important steps.
